conditions: Granum Crowns and the Granum Void don't exist for you until the quest is done.

groups.activity: Capture; spend a Granum Crown, take the next from the Treasurer
groups.meta: Rotation C at Rank 3, 75 kills solo
conditions: The crown tier decides the loot table, not the node: the Barrel needs a plain Granum Crown from a level 0-15 node.
The C roll only comes at Rank 3: 75 kills solo, plus 25 per extra squad member.
bonuses: Protea's Neuroptics and Chassis share these C tables, so farm them together if you need her.
Recycle the crown every mission: spend it at a Golden Hand Tribute early, then kill that mission's Treasurer on the way out.

disclosures.title: frame picks
disclosures.body: Octavia is the most-recommended: drop Mallet and Amp at the spawn point and barely move. Mesa's Peacemaker with Primed Flow and full energy, or Revenant's Danse Macabre from a slight rise, are the other standards. Xoris is the no-investment fallback: Charged Throw kills any Specter, and detonating near a trapped Solaris frees them for +20 seconds each. Simaris sells the Xoris again if you sold it. Iliad was named as faster than Skyresh.

groups.activity: Sabotage; spend an Exemplar Granum Crown, take the next from the Treasurer
conditions: Needs an Exemplar Crown from a level 16-30 node; a Zenith Crown never drops either part.
Tributes won't work with enemies nearby, and one Void per mission.
Freeing Solaris captives before entering can disable your abilities in the Void, and an unkilled Zanuka Hunter can yank you out.
Starting on the tile with the giant coin can leave every Tribute inactive; abort and restart.
bonuses: Triton (Rescue, Neptune) was named as faster than Adrastea.

disclosures.title: sustain
disclosures.body: Errant Specters drop no ammo or energy; bring Team Energy Restores or an ammo-efficient weapon.
